title: Night Shift
intro: Last package of the night. Rooftops only.
Drop it off and your shift is finally over.
hints: ARROWS or A/D to run. SPACE, W or UP to jump.
Hold jump to leap higher. Tap it for a hop.
SHIFT flips the grid: blue or pink goes solid.
Ghost platforms won't hold you. Flip first!
Sticky Keys popup? Press X to flip instead.
Security drone ahead. It doesn't sign for parcels.
levelHints: Ghost tile? Press SHIFT or X to make it solid.
Jump, then flip at the top. Not before!
That drone's too high to jump. Time your run.
win: All 3 drops signed for. Clock out! R to replay.
lose: Wrecked. The package is fine, though. Press R.
